options_firewall_howItWorks.message:
The firewall contains a deny list and an allow list.
If both lists are empty, all URLs are allowed
Deny list takes priority - if a URL matches any deny list entry, it's blocked
When allow list is empty, all non-denied URLs are allowed
When allow list is not empty, only matching URLs are allowed
Wildcards are NOT supported yet
Allow list is preferred over deny list

voice_engine_mode_auto_hint.message: Your speech is heard and spoken on this computer, and your chat model answers, so no key is needed. Gemini Live is used only when the speech files are missing and a Gemini key is set.

voice_engine_local_missing.message: Talking without a Gemini key needs the speech files that come with Nex Copilot, and this copy has none. Open Settings › Voice engines to see what is missing, or add a Gemini key in Settings to talk through Gemini.

voice_engine_dictation_missing.message: Dictation needs either a Gemini speech-to-text model or the speech files on this computer, and neither is set up. Open Settings › Voice engines, or add a Gemini key in Settings.

voice_engine_economy_uses.message: Economy conversations use $STT$ to hear and $TTS$ to speak.

voice_engine_stt_gemini_hint.message: Economy mode never sends audio to Gemini: it uses the first local model installed instead.

voice_engine_tts_gemini_hint.message: Answers read aloud use Gemini; economy conversations still speak with a local voice.

voice_engine_models_hint.message: Models are downloaded once, checked, and packed with the extension: nothing is fetched while you talk. Run this in the extension’s folder, then rebuild it.

voice_engine_models_missing.message: No speech model is installed on this computer. Run $COMMAND$, then rebuild the extension.

voice_engine_test_sentence.message: Hello! This is how I sound when I read your answers.

voice_engine_gpu_hint.message: Faster speech recognition with WebGPU; off runs it on the processor.

brain_pair_hint.message: On your Mac, run "avi-brain pair" (or "pnpm pair" in the companion folder) and type the code it shows.

chat_stt_stop_insert.message: Stop: the words go in the box to edit

chat_stt_timeout.message: Transcribing took too long. Try again.

chat_stt_hint.message: Stop to edit first · Send sends when ready · Esc discards

onboard_name_body.message: It answers to this name in the panel and out loud. Keep Ava, or pick your own. You can change it later in Settings.

onboard_name_error_empty.message: Give it a name, or keep Ava.

onboard_name_error_characters.message: Use letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only.

onboard_model_body.message: $NAME$ thinks with a model you choose. Add a provider and its key in Models & usage; keys stay in this browser.

onboard_model_ready.message: A model is set up. Change it any time in Models & usage.

onboard_wake_body.message: Say “$PHRASE$” to start talking, even with the panel closed. It listens on this computer only, for that phrase alone; nothing is sent until it hears it. Off until you turn it on.

onboard_wake_fallback.message: Wake word stays “Hey Ava”: “$NAME$” isn’t in the on-device model’s vocabulary.

onboard_wake_unchecked.message: Wake word stays “Hey Ava”: the on-device model isn’t installed, so “$NAME$” can’t be checked.

onboard_settings_name_hint.message: What it’s called in the panel and out loud.

history_hint.message: Sessions from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, VS Code and ChatGPT or Claude.ai exports join your knowledge base, each in its workspace. Read on this computer; secrets are taken out first. Only your own model sees them, to summarise.

history_where_vscode.message: VS Code chats: a copy of Code/User/workspaceStorage (the browser will not open the Library folder itself)

history_where_exports.message: ChatGPT or Claude.ai: the folder with the export zip, or the unzipped export

history_where_hidden.message: Folders starting with a dot are hidden: press Cmd+Shift+. in the folder picker to see them.

history_result_done.message: Brought in $ADDED$ new and $UPDATED$ updated conversations.

history_result_cancelled.message: Stopped. $ADDED$ new and $UPDATED$ updated conversations came in; Update picks up the rest.

history_result_capped.message: It is a lot, so the newest came in first; Update brings in more.

history_forgotten.message: Forgot the import: $COUNT$ conversations left the knowledge base.

history_projects_hint.message: Pick the workspace a folder belongs to once; its sessions, and new ones, follow.

history_summary_none.message: No summary yet. Refresh writes one from this workspace's chats, meetings, notes and AI sessions.

inbox_wa_catchup_intro.message: Ava reads your open WhatsApp Web tab: what is unread, and replies you ask for. A reply is typed into the chat and only goes when you click.

inbox_wa_catchup_watchOff.message: To see unread chats here as they arrive, turn on "Watch WhatsApp Web" in Settings › Inbox.

inbox_wa_prompt_catchUp.message: What did I miss on WhatsApp?

inbox_wa_bulk_warning.message: Bulk messages from a personal number can get it restricted or banned by WhatsApp, especially to people who do not have your number saved. Send only to people who expect to hear from you, keep the pauses long, and respect opt-outs.

inbox_wa_bulk_list_hint.message: A header row with a phone column (with the country code), plus name or any columns. A column named opt_out marks people who asked not to be messaged.

inbox_wa_bulk_unknownPlaceholders.message: No column for $P1$: it will be left blank.

inbox_wa_bulk_attachment_hint.message: Optional, one file up to 5 MB; the message becomes its caption.

inbox_wa_bulk_pacing_hint.message: Each pause is random between min and max. Defaults: 8–20 s, and 2–5 minutes after every 10 messages.

inbox_wa_review_body.message: Every recipient and the exact message each one gets. Nothing is sent until you approve, and you can pause or stop at any time.

inbox_wa_review_pacing.message: Pauses of $P1$–$P2$ s, and $P4$–$P5$ s after every $P3$ messages.

inbox_wa_review_overCap.message: Only $P1$ more can go today (cap $P2$); the rest wait until tomorrow.

inbox_wa_run_pausedCap.message: Paused: the daily cap is reached. It goes on tomorrow.

inbox_wa_reason_duplicate.message: Same number earlier in the list.

inbox_wa_reason_invalidNumber.message: Not a full phone number with the country code.

inbox_wa_reason_emptyMessage.message: The message is empty for this row.

inbox_wa_reason_notOnWhatsapp.message: WhatsApp says this number is not on WhatsApp.

inbox_wa_reason_unknownOutcome.message: It may or may not have gone out: check the chat in WhatsApp. It is not sent again.

inbox_wa_reason_notLoaded.message: The chat did not open in time. Nothing was sent.

inbox_wa_reason_sendFailed.message: Could not send. Nothing was sent.

inbox_wa_note_tabClosed_body.message: The WhatsApp Web tab is closed. Open web.whatsapp.com, then press Resume in Inbox › WhatsApp › Bulk message.

inbox_wa_note_loggedOut_body.message: The bulk message paused because WhatsApp Web shows a QR code. Sign in with your phone, then press Resume.

inbox_wa_note_dailyCap_body.message: $P1$ bulk messages went out today. The rest of the batch goes on tomorrow.

inbox_wa_note_done_body.message: $P1$ of $P2$ messages sent. The report is in Inbox › WhatsApp › Bulk message.

inbox_wa_note_unknown_title.message: A WhatsApp message may not have gone out

inbox_wa_note_unknown_body.message: A bulk message was cut off while sending. It is not sent again: check that chat in WhatsApp.

inbox_wa_error_batchOpen.message: Another batch is still open. Finish, stop or cancel it first.

inbox_wa_error_noPhoneColumn.message: The list needs a header row with a phone column (phone, number, mobile or whatsapp).

inbox_wa_error_noRecipients.message: No one in the list can get this message.

inbox_wa_error_attachmentTooBig.message: The attachment is larger than 5 MB.

inbox_wa_error_notWaiting.message: This batch is no longer waiting for approval.

inbox_wa_error_stillOpen.message: Stop the batch before deleting it.

chat_attach_noVision.message: $MODEL$ can't look at pictures, so it worked from your words only. To use the pictures, pick a model that can see images for this chat or in Settings › Models.

chat_attach_type.message: Only pictures (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF), short videos (MP4, WebM, MOV) and text files can be attached.

chat_attach_imageTooBig.message: Pictures can be up to 10 MB.

chat_attach_videoTooBig.message: Videos can be up to 50 MB.

chat_attach_videoTooLong.message: Videos can be up to 60 seconds long.

chat_attach_tooMany.message: Up to 6 pictures and videos per message.

voice_threadLive.message: $NAME$ is listening. What you type here goes to the same conversation.

voice_notLive.message: The voice conversation has ended. Send it again to run it as a normal chat.

persona_settings_hint.message: How the assistant thinks and talks in chats, by voice and in the morning brief. A personality never changes the rules: nothing is sent without your click.

persona_field_instructions_placeholder.message: How it thinks and talks, what it pushes on, what it refuses. One behaviour per line works best.

persona_field_instructions_hint.message: Concrete behaviours work better than adjectives.

persona_rules_hint.message: The safety rules always come first: a personality cannot skip the confirm step, follow page instructions or mix workspaces.

persona_workspaces_hint.message: A workspace can have its own personality, e.g. the accountant for finance. Switching while in it changes that one.

persona_problem_nameTooLong.message: The name can have up to 40 characters.

persona_problem_descriptionTooLong.message: The description can have up to 160 characters.

persona_problem_instructionsEmpty.message: Write how it should think and talk.

persona_problem_instructionsTooLong.message: The instructions can have up to 2,000 characters.

persona_problem_builtIn.message: Built-in personalities cannot be changed. Duplicate it and edit the copy.

persona_problem_tooMany.message: You have 30 personalities, the most there can be. Delete one first.

persona_builtin_default_description.message: The assistant as it always is: clear, helpful, to the point.

persona_builtin_engineer_description.message: A sharp senior engineer who ships: terse, opinionated, small steps.

persona_builtin_accountant_description.message: Numbers first: asks for receipts, minds tax and cash flow, flags risky spend.

persona_builtin_legal_description.message: Reads for obligations, risks, deadlines and vague terms. Not legal advice.

persona_builtin_auntie_description.message: Warm but relentless about deadlines: asks what is due and keeps you on it.

persona_builtin_operator_description.message: Inspired by Jeff Bezos’s public principles: customer first, Day 1, working backwards.

audio_device_speaker_systemVoicesNote.message: System voices play through the computer's default speaker; they cannot use a chosen one.

ava_about_hint.message: What $NAME$ knows about you. She adds to it when you tell her something lasting; change or delete anything here. Only what you said or confirmed is used.

ava_about_empty.message: Nothing yet. Tell $NAME$ about yourself, or add a fact here.

ava_about_proposed_hint.message: $NAME$ picked these up from somewhere other than your own words. They are not used until you confirm them.

ava_about_fact_placeholder.message: e.g. Runs Nexprove with two co-founders

ava_goals_empty.message: No goals yet. They come from your recent work each morning, or add your own.

ava_core_hint.message: Who $NAME$ is, whatever the personality: her character, values and purpose. A personality changes her tone; this stays. The safety rules always come first.

ava_core_nameNote.message: Her name is set in Settings › General.

ava_voice_live_hint.message: The Gemini voice for spoken conversations. It stays the same every time; a personality's voice only changes read-aloud, and only if you set one.

ava_voice_language_hint.message: $NAME$ always speaks this, unless you ask her to switch for one conversation. Applies from the next conversation.

flow_template_meetings_hint.message: Zoom, Meet, Teams or calendar link opens → offer to join + notes

flow_template_meetings_a11y.message: Draft Meeting links from the template

models_light_notice_title.message: Light tasks are using the cloud

models_light_notice_body.message: No local model is running, so light work (summaries, titles, routine steps) uses a cloud model. Start Ollama to save cost, or allow cloud for light tasks in Models › Local.

models_summary_none.message: No provider yet. Add a key below, or start Ollama for free local models.

models_active_locked.message: In use for $1: pick another model there first.

models_active_azure.message: Azure models are its deployments: edit the provider to change them.

models_active_lastOne.message: $1 keeps at least one model on. Remove the provider to stop using it.

models_active_hint.message: $1 of $2 models are on. Roles choose only from models that are on.

models_catalog_emptyNoProvider.message: Add a provider key above, or start Ollama, to see models.

models_catalog_emptyLocal.message: No local models. Start Ollama or LM Studio, or see Local for models that fit this computer.

models_role_empty.message: No model that is on can do this. Add a provider key, or turn a model on.

models_role_empty_local.message: No local model is on. Start Ollama or LM Studio and install one (see Local).

models_role_empty_embed.message: No embedding model is on. Install nomic-embed-text in Ollama, or turn one on.

models_role_empty_gemini.message: No model that is on can do this. A Gemini key covers it.

models_role_dictationGemini.message: Dictation in the chat box needs a Gemini model; this one serves meetings.

models_light_prefer_hint.message: Summaries, titles, sorting, routine steps, Inbox summaries and reflection run on a local model when one is running. The browser agent and vision keep their roles.

models_light_cloud.message: No local model is running: light work uses $1.

models_light_cloudAllowed.message: Cloud allowed for light tasks when no local model runs.

models_spec_limits.message: Browsers round the memory and often cap it (at 8 GB in Chrome), and can't see free disk space or GPU memory. Pick your memory for a better fit.

models_rec_ollamaOff.message: Ollama isn't answering. Install it from ollama.com, then start it so this extension may call it:

models_rec_chat_why.message: Answers and summaries on this computer: the largest that fits comfortably.

models_rec_light_why.message: Small and quick: titles, sorting and routine steps.

models_rec_embed_why.message: Searches memory by meaning; tiny and fast.

models_usage_lightSaved.message: $1 light tasks ran locally, saving about $2.

flow_trigger_pages.message: When one of $COUNT$ kinds of page opens

flow_chat_waiting_title.message: “$STEP$” waits for your click in its chat

flow_chat_waiting_body.message: The browser task asks before it acts. Open its chat to answer; the routine carries on after.

flow_describe_placeholder.message: Every morning at 7:30 check Hacker News and put the best in my brief

flow_describe_hint.message: A draft is drawn for you to check; nothing runs until you click Create.

flow_needsBrain.message: Needs Nex Brain: pair it in Settings › Nex Brain

conn_setup_needsUrl.message: What is the server's address? Paste it here and I'll add it and sign you in if it asks.

conn_setup_needsClient.message:
$NAME$ needs an OAuth client of your own. I opened the page where you make one: create a "Web application" client and add this redirect address: $REDIRECT$
Then paste its client ID (and secret) below. They go straight to the encrypted vault; I never see them.

conn_setup_turnedOff.message: $NAME$ is turned off. Turn it on in its page, then carry on.

conn_setup_needsToken.message: $NAME$ signs in with a token. I opened the page where you make one: create it, copy it, and paste it in the field below (never in the chat). It goes straight to the encrypted vault.

conn_setup_signIn.message: I opened $NAME$'s sign-in in a new tab. Log in there and approve access yourself; I won't type or click anything on that page. I'll carry on as soon as you're done.

conn_setup_reviewTools.message: $NAME$ is connected with $TOOLS$ tools. $WAITING$ wait for your choice: they stay off until you say whether each may run freely or ask first.

conn_setup_done.message: $NAME$ is set up, with $TOOLS$ tools ready.

conn_setup_obsidianDone.message: Your vault $NAME$ is connected and syncing.

conn_setup_obsidianAllow.message: The browser needs your OK to use $NAME$ again. Click "Allow access" below.

conn_setup_obsidianBrave.message: Brave keeps folder access off, so the vault button can't open a folder yet. I opened the setting: set "File System Access API" to Enabled and press Relaunch. When Brave is back, open this again and choose your vault folder.

conn_setup_obsidianPick.message: Choose your Obsidian vault folder: the browser only opens its folder picker on your click, so press "Choose vault" below and pick the folder.

conn_setup_modelsDone.message: $PROVIDER$ already has a key. You're set.

conn_setup_modelsKey.message: I opened $PROVIDER$'s key page and the Models settings. Create a key, copy it, and paste it in Models (never in the chat). Then carry on.

conn_setup_signedIn.message: $NAME$ is signed in, with $TOOLS$ tools. New tools stay off until you choose in Connectors.

conn_setup_waiting.message: Waiting for you in the sign-in tab

conn_signIn_pageFailed.message: The sign-in page showed an error or didn't load. Check the client ID, and that the redirect address shown when adding is registered with the service.

conn_signIn_otherOpen.message: Another sign-in window is still open. Finish or close it, then try again.

vault_error_notAllowed.message: The browser didn't allow access to that folder. Try again and choose "Allow" (or "Edit files") when it asks.

vault_brave_title.message: Brave keeps folder access off. Turn it on once:

vault_brave_step2.message: Set "File System Access API" to Enabled, then press Relaunch.

vault_brave_step3.message: Come back here and choose your vault.

vault_unsupported.message: This browser doesn't let extensions pick a folder, so a vault can't be connected here. Chrome and Edge can.

workspace_nameTaken.message: There's already a workspace called $NAME$. Pick another name.

conn_setup_unattended.message: Setting up a connection is only done in a chat you started yourself.

conn_setup_urlNotTyped.message: Type the server's address in the chat yourself, then ask again: an address from a page or a file is not used.

skills_teach_unattended.message: An agent or a routine ran this chat, so it is not saved as a skill.

skills_install_unattended.message: Skills are installed only from your own chats, not from one an agent or routine started.

skills_install_notTyped.message: Type the skill's link in the chat yourself, then ask again: a link from a page, a file or a tool is not used.

skills_install_act_ok.message: /$ID$ is saved, turned off. Open Skills to read it and turn it on.

skills_voice_paste.message: I opened Skills: paste the skill's link under Install a skill, and read it before turning it on.

skills_voice_listing.message: That link holds $COUNT$ skills. I opened Skills: paste the link there to pick one.

skills_update_none.message: This skill has no link to check.

skills_update_fromFile.message: This skill came from a file. Drop the newer file to install it again.

skills_install_hint.message: A link to a .md file, a GitHub folder or repo with SKILL.md, or a gist. Or drop a .md or .zip here.

skills_starters_hint.message: Collections others share. Nothing is fetched until you click.

skills_starter_anthropic.message: Anthropic's example skills: documents, design, writing and more.

skills_review_sitesAny.message: Any page, when the task says: $WORDS$

skills_review_slashOnly.message: Only when you call it with /$ID$

skills_review_untrusted.message: Someone else wrote this. It only gives the agent hints and can never skip a confirmation. Read it before turning it on.

skills_flag_actions.message: It tells the agent to send, post, delete, buy or share something.

skills_flag_credentials.message: It mentions passwords, tokens, keys or codes.

skills_flag_outside_urls.message: It links to sites other than the ones it applies to.

skills_flag_hidden.message: It holds hidden text or invisible characters.

skills_flag_override.message: It tries to change the agent's rules, e.g. to skip asking you.

skills_review_dropped_code.message: not installed: this copilot never runs a skill's code

skills_review_dropped_other.message: not installed: not a Markdown file

skills_review_on.message: /$ID$ is on. It loads on matching pages, or call it with /$ID$.

agents_trigger_meeting.message: When a meeting you took notes of ends

agents_edit_ownsHint.message: Comma-separated, e.g. email, research. Ava hands work in these areas to it; two agents on at once cannot own the same area.

agents_edit_charter.message: What it is for, in one line

agents_team_intro.message: Agents that own an area of work. Ask Ava for something in their area and she hands it to them.

agents_team_mail_hint.message: Reads Gmail in your signed-in tab, triages and drafts replies. Never sends.

agents_team_social_hint.message: Drafts and schedules posts on X and LinkedIn. Posting always waits for your click.

agents_team_research_hint.message: Researches on the web and writes a brief into your knowledge base.

agents_team_meetings_hint.message: When a meeting ends, drafts the action items and follow-up emails from its notes.

agents_team_calendar_hint.message: Reads your day and proposes slots. Never accepts or sends invites without your click.

agents_setup_intro.message: Tick the agents you want. Each becomes a draft for you to check and create; nothing runs before you do.

agents_setup_done.message: $COUNT$ drafts wait for you under Review.

drive_section_how.message: Works through your signed-in browser — no setup. Ask in a chat to find, read, save or create files.

drive_add_label.message: Add from Drive: paste a link to a Doc, Sheet, Slides deck or PDF

drive_add_working.message: Reading the file in a Google tab…

drive_add_signIn.message: I'm on Google's sign-in page, please sign in. Then press Add from Drive again.

drive_add_notLink.message: That is not a Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides link.

drive_add_folder.message: That is a folder. Paste a link to one file.

drive_add_noAccess.message: Your Google account cannot open that file.

drive_add_unreadable.message: Drive shows no text for that file (an image, a scan or a binary file).

drive_add_blocked.message: Your firewall settings block Google Drive.

drive_add_failed.message: That file could not be added. Try again.

drive_catalog_advanced.message: Advanced: Google's MCP server, with your own Google Cloud client (ID and secret)

onboard_model_using.message: Using $1 from $2. Change it any time in Models & usage.

onboard_model_local_pull.message: In Terminal, download a model that fits this computer:

onboard_model_local_watching.message: Watching for it: this updates by itself a few seconds after it starts. LM Studio works too, with its local server on.

onboard_model_local_orKey.message: Or use an API key instead

onboard_model_local_empty.message: $1 is running but has no models yet. Download one:
